explanation: Compared against Green Problem 69: Elekes–Szabó conjecture that if A has cn² collinear triples, some 10 points of A lie on a cubic. The statement uses triple lines rather than collinear triples, and the docstring correctly argues equivalence (10 collinear points lie on a cubic; otherwise each line carries ≤ C(9,3) triples). It requires |A| > n₀(c), needed to exclude small configurations. Faithful.
